protocol.primary_unit: mean absolute error between corresponding signed x/y derivatives in stretched code units
protocol.primary_reduction: median across informative patches within each view/light condition
protocol.stretch: unchanged v102 per-image min-max contrast_u8 applied to prediction and odd target
protocol.informative_target: at least 5% of native intra-patch horizontal/vertical raw grayscale edges differ by >=2 codes
protocol.raw_grayscale: Pillow L conversion of original sRGB PNG; linear method uses exact v102 sRGB conversion
protocol.comparison: positive nearest-minus-composite error difference favors synthesis, common scored support only
protocol.low_signal: report unsupported target windows and predicted texture in them; record target stretch too
protocol.aggregation: report all, 1/17, each illumination, each terrain and terrain macro medians without independence claims

scope: Reference-role same-camera reconstruction of withheld odd renderer states. Odd pixels are read after the metadata-only plan is fixed. No query-view, matcher, navigation, transfer or visibility conclusion.
